text.value: The master-metered customer's electricity consumption will be billed using the total kWh usage of the master-meter divided by the number of occupied single-family accommodations. The billing calculation will include applicable discounts to all kWh Usage Charges and System Infrastructure Fixed Charge (SIFC) for qualifying energy assistance and medical equipment discount program participants. The customer must advise SMUD within 15 days following any change in the number of occupied single-family accommodations wired for electric service.

provenance.snippet: 2.
